evidence: gpt-oss-120b immediately translates '(s_a - t_a) * (s_b - t_b) = 0' into the literal clause '(x_idx == val)' and builds 2-SAT implication edges directly from the factors.
removal_suggestion: Expand the algebraic equation into its expanded multilinear form $s_{|l_1|} s_{|l_2|} - t(l_1) s_{|l_2|} - t(l_2) s_{|l_1|} + t(l_1) t(l_2) = 0$, or frame the interlock as an energy-penalty function that must sum to zero across all pairs.

common_affordance: The explicit factored zero-product equation $(s_{|l_1|} - t(l_1)) \times (s_{|l_2|} - t(l_2)) = 0$ mapping 1-to-1 to a 2-SAT clause

regression_risk: deepseek-v4-flash or glm-5 might switch from an over-engineered/buggy graph approach to another representation, but any correct solution still requires 2-SAT, so fixing/breaking will primarily depend on whether they properly implement Tarjan/Kosaraju.
